applies_why: This judge text declares Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED because the parties give two readings of the conception agency, treating the verse as open due to those two senses.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. -- one reading: two senses leave the verse open and can support UNDERDETERMINED; the other: two senses are not open and both stand.
why: Under K-S2, a verse carrying two senses at once is not open and both senses stand, so the judge's UNDERDETERMINED result grounded on the two readings breaches the rule.
